title: Grudge Sword
description: A grudge sword that gets more powerful everytime you die.
body:
⚔️ Grudge Sword
The sword that grows stronger every time you die.
The Grudge Sword is a unique weapon that feeds on your suffering. Every death makes it more powerful — so the worse you play, the better your sword gets.

Each death adds +0.5 bonus damage. At 50 deaths you deal +25 bonus damage on top of diamond sword base damage.

✨ Features

5 visual texture stages — the blade fills with glowing red cracks as you die more
Death counter shown in item name: Grudge Sword [12]
Flame + crit particles on hit
Action bar shows your current grudge level on death
Chat message when you reach a new tier

Recipe: Obsidian = O Diamond Sword = D and Blaze Rod = B X = Air
